title: feat(welcome): dynamic canvas card + Redis hot-reload + dashboard config UI
body:
## Summary

Welcome system upgrade across **gateway** and **dashboard**: dynamic per-join canvas cards, premium embed redesign, Redis hot-reloadable config, and a new Liquid-Glass admin page with a WYSIWYG preview.

End-to-end flow now: admin edits `/welcome` → `PUT /api/welcome-config` → Mongo upsert → Redis publish `welcome:config:updated` → gateway refreshes in-memory cache → next join uses the new config (no reboot).

### Gateway

- `@napi-rs/canvas` welcome card (`WelcomeCard.ts`) — dark gradient bg, cyan `#00FFAA` neon border + halo, circular avatar clip, gradient underline accent, member-count footer; returned as an `AttachmentBuilder` and referenced via `attachment://...` in the embed.
- `WelcomeHandler.ts` refactored to drive everything off `WelcomeConfigData` (toggles, templates with `{member}/{mention}/{guild}/{memberCount}`, hex accent/border colors, auto-roles). Embed gets gold `#FFD700` accent and live "Member Count" / "Status" fields.
- `WelcomeConfigStore` — per-guild in-memory cache + lazy Mongo load + Redis `WELCOME_CONFIG_UPDATED` subscriber that calls `refresh(guildId)` on event. Subscription wired in `gateway/src/index.ts` post-Redis init.
- `client.ts` now delegates fully to `WelcomeHandlers.handleMemberJoin/Leave` (raid detector still gates joins first).

### Shared

- `WelcomeConfig` Mongoose model + `WelcomeConfigData` plain type + `DEFAULT_WELCOME_CONFIG` (hex color validation, `welcome_configs` collection, unique `guildId` index).
- New `EventTypes.WELCOME_CONFIG_UPDATED = 'welcome:config:updated'` and typed `WelcomeConfigUpdatedPayload { guildId, updatedBy, committedAt }` in `EventPayloadMap`.

### Dashboard

- `services/dashboard/src/pages/WelcomeConfig.tsx` — Liquid Glass control panel (`backdrop-blur-md bg-white/5 border border-white/10`), cyan-glow focus rings, color/text/toggle fields, and a sticky **WYSIWYG** preview that mirrors the final Discord embed + canvas card (CSS/SVG only, no client-side canvas needed).
- Wired into `dashboardStore.ts` with `welcomeConfig`, `fetchWelcomeConfig`, `updateWelcomeConfig`, `saveWelcomeConfig` (typed `Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error }>`). Route added at `/welcome`, sidebar entry under Layout.
- `services/dashboard/server/index.ts` — `GET/PUT /api/welcome-config` (guarded by `requireAuth`/`requireAdmin`), strict validation of booleans/strings/hex colors/role-id arrays, then `redisClient.publish(EventTypes.WELCOME_CONFIG_UPDATED, { source, payload })` on success.

### Verified

- `pnpm -r build` → exit 0 across all 6 packages, zero `any`, no `TS6133`.
- Live test: `redis-cli PUBLISH 'avenlo:events:welcome:config:updated' '<event>'` → gateway logs `🔁 Welcome config refreshed for guild <id>`.
- Bot starts cleanly: `welcome-config-store: Subscribed to WELCOME_CONFIG_UPDATED events`.
